Open Items in Dunning

Once you have created the move-out. you have the option of applying an alternative dunning procedure to the contracts in the
move-out. You can also deactivate the dunning procedure that is currently active by specifying a dunning block reason due to the
move-out. This data can also be defined as default data by making the neessary Customizing settings.

Move-Out Status

If you edit or display a move-out document, the system displays the move-out status for every contract. This shows how far you
have completed move-out processing for this contract.

The system calculates the minimum status from the move-out status and also displays this. This means that you have quick
access to the status of overall move-out processing.

Move-Out Documents

If you display move-out documents for a business partner or premise, the system displays documents for the last three months. If
no documents exist for this period, the system displays the documents from the last six months.

Final Billing

You have the option of triggering an immediate bill for contracts in the move-out from move-out processing, once move-out status
05 (meter readings entered completely) has been reached for the entire move-out. During this process, billing, invoicing and then
the bill print are accessed.

Activities
Screen Layout

In Customizing under |)sMove-In/Out  Move-Out - Configure Tabs for Move-Out Screen “J, you can configure various views of the

data available on the move-out screen. This consists of various tab pages that you can use to divide the data into various logical
units according to your requirements.

For more information, see Screen Layout.

Move-Out Date

You can subsequently change the move-out date for a move-out that has already been created without affecting the date of the
subsequent move-in. You cannot change the date for contracts that have already been billed or for a contract and customer
change.

Actual Move-Out Date
In addition to the move-out date, you can also enter an alternative actual move-in date.
Save
